versions.content: A unique order in which multiple spinlocks can be occupied by a TASK/ISR2 on one core should be configurable in the AUTOSAR Operating System. This might be realized by the configuration item (OsSpinlockSuccessor{NEXT_SPINLOCK}) where “NEXT_SPINLOCK” refers to the consecutive spinlock. (See page 219)
